primary_effort: Consolidate qualified landing-to-rebound patterns across directions at a lower overall impact dose.
readiness_gate: Use E3 connected lateral bounds only with an actual controlled prior lateral-return exposure and acceptable response; use E5 connected broad jumps only with actual controlled prior forward-rebound practice and acceptable response. Both require current readiness. Qualification in one direction does not qualify the other. Missing evidence selects the corresponding held-landing replacement independently. Keep amplitude, displacement and all strength loads stable; this is consolidation, not another increase.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Retain a small bilateral braking reference before single-leg acceptance. Use a controllable vertical jump, coordinated ankle/knee/hip yielding and a 2 s hold. Lower height for stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 6 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Prepare low-amplitude ankle return without tiring the receiving legs. Stay tall, knees soft and feet centered; settle the last contact. Reduce amplitude or stop for heavy contacts/knee pumping.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — two connected out-and-back bounds (proposed variant)
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 bounds per starting leg = 4 bounds total.** One two-bound sequence starting left, one starting right. **60 s between starting legs; 120 s before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary directional quality task:** retain the small lateral reversal with half the prior listed sequences. Bound onto the other leg and immediately return, then hold 2 s. Keep pelvis and knee aligned over the contact; reduce distance or use discrete stops if a shuffle, extra dip or collapse appears.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — three connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 3 jumps = 6 landings / 4 transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Retain the familiar bilateral elastic reference after the primary receiving-leg task. Use the same qualified moderate height, natural arm swing and continuous reversal; settle the third landing for 2 s. Lower amplitude or use the two-jump regression if the second transition deteriorates.

explosive.name: Repeated Broad Jump — two connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 jumps = 4 landings / 2 forward rebound transitions. 120 s between sets and before E6.**
explosive.job: Consolidate a separately qualified forward landing-to-takeoff pattern at a small dose. Use modest displacement and natural arm swing, continuous reversal without a gather and a 2 s final stop. Shorten distance or use held broad jumps if reaching or uncontrolled travel appears.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 low hops per leg = 6 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Keep a minimal but real one-leg ankle rhythm exposure while directional practice shares the session. Stay centered over the foot with a softly organized knee; settle the third hop. Use lower amplitude/support or stop if alignment or rhythm is lost.

replacement_routes.description: Both connected directions: 28 landings = 18 bilateral + 10 single-leg; 17 transitions; 46 limb contacts. Holding one direction keeps 28 landings with 15 transitions; holding both keeps 28 with 13. E3 held route takes 200 s versus 190; E5 held route 280 s versus 250. Both together add 40 s, included in the upper time allowance.

E4 two-jump regression produces 26 landings, 16 bilateral + 10 single-leg and 42 limb contacts. Transition totals are 15 with both directions connected, 13 with one held, or 11 with both held; E4 takes about 2 s less.

next_intended_job: Class 9 can revisit a small self-generated vertical amplitude change at a fixed two-set dose; use familiar amplitude unless real response supports the change.
